source: Authored for S06 (Issue #145) from the internal-rediscovery rule in docs/architecture/connection.md#supervised-reconnect: one bounded rediscovery of the saved UUID, never the caller-facing scan. Not captured from a physical television.
redaction: Contains no address, MAC, Wi-Fi name, token, serial or certificate. Hosts are placeholders such as [host-b]; address-like and identifying device-info fields are replaced with bracketed placeholders; UUIDs are randomly generated for this fixture.
notes: The saved television is rediscovered at a new address while a second television with a different UUID answers the same probes. Rediscovery may accept only the saved UUID, so the second television is never a match.
